notes.title: THE RAT SUMMER UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1248730/ss_a8e7080f14f6b1b71ed424b3fb57d5adeac3f9a3.1920x1080.jpg?t=1690418944[/img]

🐀 Greetings, Rattus enthusiasts!

We are thrilled to announce the arrival of a new update for Rattus - the game you all love and adore! Prepare yourselves for the most challenging experience yet, as "Rattus EX" brings a wave of turmoil and chaos to the world of birds! We've poured our hearts into elevating the visuals and tweaking the game mechanics for an even more immersive arcade experience!

🌟 Remastered Graphics 🌟

Prepare to be dazzled as we unveil a visual feast for your eyes! We've meticulously remastered the graphics, breathing new life into the world of Rattus. Enjoy enhanced sprites, and mesmerizing visual effects that will amplify your gaming experience. 

🎮 Tweaked Game Mechanics 🎮

We've made subtle adjustments to the game mechanics to enhance the overall gameplay flow. Expect augmented challenge, emergent challenges, and improved enemy behavior, making every moment in Rattus an exhilarating and enjoyable struggle against the bird army.
